facts.headline: The AI Compute Bottleneck Is Becoming a Power Problem
facts.summary: The AI compute bottleneck is no longer only a chip or model problem. New claims from Subquadratic and Tensordyne point toward efficiency pressure, while data-center flexibility and orbital-compute proposals show the same constraint moving into power, cooling, capital, and public infrastructure.
